## What and why

## Kind of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Test harness
- [ ] ADR proposal

## Checks that always apply

- [ ] Tests added or changed (tagged with the ADR id where an ADR secures the change)
- [ ] No owner-only path (see CODEOWNERS) merged without the owner's review of the latest push; `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `.github/**` need the independent reviewer's approval (the owner's review until it exists)
- [ ] ADR proposed (status `Proposed`) if a decision would change; existing ADRs are changed only by the owner

<!-- UI CHECKLIST: start. Only for pull requests that change UI (ADR-064). Delete this block for non-UI changes. -->

## UI checklist (ADR-064)

- [ ] Principles checked against the UX principles in `docs/ux-concept.md`
- [ ] Terms used as defined in the Terms section of `docs/ux-concept.md`
- [ ] Design tokens only: no raw colours or sizes in components
- [ ] Sketch linked (stored in `docs/ux/sketches/`, linked from its UX decision, e.g. D-46, D-47)
- [ ] Screenshots attached from the UI specifications: phone and tablet, light and dark
- [ ] Link to this pull request's preview address (Azure Static Web Apps, ADR-047)
- [ ] Keyboard paths covered; accessible names, roles and live-region announcements checked by specs and component rules

<!-- UI CHECKLIST: end -->
